entities.summary:
Robert Schirokauer Hartman 
was a German-American logician and philosopher. His primary field of study was scientific axiology and he is known as its original theorist. His axiology is the basis of the Hartman Value Inventory (also known as the "Hartman Value Profile ", which is used in psychology to measure the character of an individual.
